data.description:
## Context / Problem
On `origin/main` at `c019920390926d543a0813d4c0c8721543d98776`, the `review_interrupts_signal_unavailable` alarm description in `infra/terraform/monitoring_autodeploy.tf` says “1-datapoint latch,” but the resource is configured as a 2-of-4 evaluation window. The heredoc is an executable Terraform value, so correcting it is outside comment-only remediation.

## Approach
Make the alarm description state the configured evaluation rule and add a focused assertion that description and resource settings cannot drift.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The alarm description accurately states the configured 2-of-4 window.
- [ ] A focused test fails if the prose and `datapoints_to_alarm`/`evaluation_periods` diverge.
- [ ] Terraform format/validate, focused monitoring tests, lint, and typecheck pass.
data.title: Correct review-interrupt signal alarm description to its 2-of-4 evaluation window
